_about: Coaching layer over free-exercise-db for the exercises plans use. Written by the FitMind team from standard strength and conditioning practice; 'reviewed' turns true only after a certified trainer checks the entry. 'fixes' corrects known errors in the source data. 'needs' lists required equipment (onboarding values; 'a|b' means either; empty means bodyweight). 'loads' lists joints the exercise stresses, used to avoid injured areas. 'rep_range' fixes the reps for explosive exercises whatever the goal.

exercises.grip: No grip. Arms forward or hands together at the chest for balance.
exercises.stance: Feet shoulder-width apart or slightly wider, toes turned out 15 to 30 degrees.
steps: Stand tall and brace your stomach.
Sit down and back between your heels, letting knees travel forward over the toes.
Go as low as you can while keeping your heels down and back neutral.
Push the floor away to stand up.
cues: Knees follow the line of your toes.
Whole foot stays on the floor.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back at the bottom.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in on the way down, out as you stand.

exercises.grip: Hold one dumbbell vertically or a kettlebell by the horns, close to your chest.
exercises.stance: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
steps: Hold the weight at chest height with elbows pointing down.
Squat down between your heels, keeping the weight close.
Lower until your elbows are near your knees or your back starts to round.
Drive up through the whole foot.
cues: Weight stays glued to your chest.
Elbows inside the knees at the bottom.
Stay tall through the upper back.
mistakes: Letting the weight drift away from the body.
exercises.breathing: Big breath and brace before going down, breathe out near the top.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip just outside the shoulders, bar resting on the upper back (not the neck).
exercises.stance: Feet shoulder-width apart or a little wider, toes turned out.
steps: Set the bar in a rack at chest height and step under it.
Brace, stand the bar up and take two small steps back.
Squat down between your heels to at least thigh parallel if mobility allows.
Drive up, keeping chest and hips rising together.
cues: Knees track over the toes; going past the toes is fine.
Use safety pins set just below your bottom position.
mistakes: Hips shooting up faster than the chest.
Knees caving in on the way up.
Squatting without safety pins or a spotter.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in and brace at the top, hold through the bottom, breathe out near the top.

exercises.grip: Hands on hips, or hold a wall for balance.
exercises.stance: Staggered: one foot forward, one back, about a long stride apart, feet hip-width apart side to side.
steps: Stand in a split stance with weight mostly on the front foot.
Lower straight down until the back knee is just above the floor.
Push through the front foot to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
cues: Move up and down like an elevator, not forward.
mistakes: Feet in a straight line (balance problems).
Pushing mostly off the back leg.
exercises.breathing: In on the way down, out as you rise.

exercises.grip: Hands on hips or arms relaxed at the sides.
exercises.stance: Start with feet hip-width apart; each step is a long stride.
steps: Take a long step forward.
Lower until the back knee is just above the floor.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg through into the next step.
Alternate legs as you walk.
cues: Step long enough that the front shin stays fairly upright.
mistakes: Short steps that load the front knee hard.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you step through.

exercises.grip: Neutral grip, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart, stepping forward into a long stride.
steps: Stand tall holding the dumbbells.
Step forward and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back to standing through the front heel.
Alternate legs.
exercises.breathing: In on the way down, out as you push back.

exercises.grip: Neutral grip, dumbbells at your sides.
exercises.stance: Whole working foot on a box or bench about knee height.
steps: Place one foot fully on the step.
Lean slightly forward and drive through that foot to stand on the step.
Lower back down slowly with control.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
cues: The top leg does the work; don't push off the bottom foot.
mistakes: Step too high for your control.
exercises.breathing: Out as you step up, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip just outside the thighs.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart, knees softly bent.
steps: Stand tall holding the bar at your thighs.
Push your hips back, sliding the bar down your legs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, usually mid-shin, with a flat back.
Drive the hips forward to stand.
cues: Bar stays in contact with the legs.
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach lower.
Turning it into a squat by bending the knees a lot.
Bar drifting away from the legs.
exercises.breathing: Brace and breathe in at the top, out as you stand.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip, dumbbells in front of the thighs.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent and fixed.
steps: Stand tall with the dumbbells in front of you.
Hinge at the hips, sliding the weights down close to your legs.
Stop when your hamstrings are fully stretched and the back is still flat.
Squeeze the glutes to return to standing.
cues: Push your hips toward the wall behind you.
exercises.breathing: In at the top, out as you stand.

exercises.grip: Overhand or mixed grip just outside the legs.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart, bar over the middle of the foot.
steps: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and hinge down to grip it.
Bring shins to the bar, chest up, back flat.
Brace and push the floor away until you stand tall.
Lower by pushing the hips back, then bending the knees.
cues: Take the slack out of the bar before pulling.
Bar travels in a straight line close to the body.
Finish with glutes, not by leaning back.
mistakes: Jerking the bar off the floor.
exercises.breathing: Big breath and brace before each rep, breathe out at the top.

exercises.grip: Arms flat on the floor by your sides.
exercises.stance: Lying on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart near your glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Press through your heels and lift your hips until body forms a line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze the glutes and pause for a second.
Lower slowly.
cues: Ribs down so the lower back doesn't arch.
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of using the glutes.
Feet too far from the body.
exercises.breathing: Out as you lift, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Arms flat on the floor by your sides.
exercises.stance: One foot flat on the floor, the other leg extended or knee pulled to the chest.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg lifted.
Drive through the planted heel to lift the hips.
Keep the hips level at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch sides after the set.
cues: Hips stay level, don't let one side drop.
exercises.breathing: Out as you lift, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Hold the side handles lightly.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-to-shoulder-width on the middle of the platform.
steps: Sit with your back and hips flat against the pad.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knees are around 90 degrees or your hips start to lift.
Press back up without locking the knees hard.
mistakes: Lowering so far the hips curl up off the seat.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Hold the handles at the front of the machine.
exercises.stance: Lying face down, pad just above the heels, knees just off the bench edge.
steps: Lie face down with the pad behind your ankles.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to almost straight.
cues: Hips stay down on the bench.
mistakes: Hips lifting to swing the weight.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Hold the side handles.
exercises.stance: Seated, back against the pad, knees lined up with the machine's pivot.
steps: Adjust the pad to sit just above the ankles.
Straighten your legs fully.
Squeeze the thighs for a second.
Lower with control.
cues: Knee joint lines up with the pivot point.
mistakes: Seat set so knees aren't aligned.
exercises.breathing: Out as you extend, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Hold a wall or rail lightly for balance.
exercises.stance: Balls of the feet on a step edge, heels hanging off, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Stand on the step edge.
Lower your heels below the step to stretch the calves.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Rolling onto the outer edge of the foot.
exercises.breathing: Out as you rise, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Hands flat, slightly wider than shoulders, fingers forward.
exercises.stance: Feet together or hip-width apart, body in a straight line from head to heels.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from the body.
Go until the chest is just above the floor.
Push the floor away to return.
cues: Body moves as one straight plank.
Elbows angle back, not flared out to the sides.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you push up.

exercises.grip: Hands on a sturdy table, counter or wall, slightly wider than shoulders.
exercises.stance: Feet together, body straight and leaning on the hands.
steps: Place hands on a stable raised surface.
Walk your feet back until the body is straight.
Lower your chest to the edge.
Push back up.
cues: The higher the surface, the easier it is.
Straight line from head to heels.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you push.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip, palms facing your feet, or slightly turned in.
exercises.stance: Lying on a flat bench, feet flat on the floor.
steps: Lie back holding the dumbbells over your chest.
Lower them to the sides of the chest, elbows about 45 degrees.
Press up until the arms are straight.
Bring the dumbbells slightly together at the top.
cues: Shoulder blades pulled back and down.
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the bench.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip a little wider than shoulders, wrists stacked over elbows.
exercises.stance: Lying on the bench, eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor.
steps: Pull your shoulder blades back and down.
Unrack the bar over your shoulders.
Lower it to the lower chest with elbows at about 45 to 70 degrees.
Press back up over the shoulders.
cues: Use a spotter or safety arms.
Touch the same spot each rep.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in and brace before lowering, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Overhand or slightly turned-in grip.
exercises.stance: Bench set to 30 to 45 degrees, feet flat on the floor.
steps: Sit back on the incline with the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press them up over the upper chest.
Lower slowly to the sides of the upper chest.
Repeat.
cues: Elbows slightly in front of the body.
mistakes: Bench set too steep (becomes a shoulder press).
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Overhand or neutral grip, dumbbells at shoulder height.
exercises.stance: Seated with back support, or standing with feet hip-width apart.
steps: Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press them overhead until the arms are straight.
Lower with control to ear or chin height.
Repeat.
cues: Press slightly in front of the head.
mistakes: Clanging the weights at the top.
exercises.breathing: Out as you press, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip just outside the shoulders, forearms vertical.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart, glutes and stomach tight.
steps: Start with the bar on the front of the shoulders.
Move your head back slightly and press the bar straight up.
Bring your head through once the bar passes it.
Lower the bar to the shoulders.
cues: Bar path is a straight line.
Squeeze glutes to protect the lower back.
exercises.breathing: Brace before pressing, breathe out at the top.

exercises.grip: Neutral grip, light dumbbells at your sides.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart, slight lean forward.
steps: Hold light dumbbells at your sides with a slight elbow bend.
Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
exercises.breathing: Out as you raise, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Hands on the edge of a sturdy chair or bench, fingers forward, shoulder-width apart.
exercises.stance: Knees bent and feet flat (easier) or legs straight (harder).
steps: Sit on the edge and place your hands beside your hips.
Slide your hips off the edge.
Bend your elbows to lower until they reach about 90 degrees.
Press back up.
cues: Stop at 90 degrees if shoulders feel strained.
mistakes: Going too deep and straining the front of the shoulder.
Using a chair that can slide.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you press.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip on a straight or angled bar, hands about shoulder-width.
exercises.stance: Standing close to the cable, feet hip-width, slight forward lean.
steps: Hold the bar with elbows tucked at your sides.
Push down until the arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps.
Let the bar rise until forearms are about parallel to the floor.
cues: Elbows stay pinned to your sides.
mistakes: Leaning over the bar to push with body weight.
exercises.breathing: Out as you push down, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Both hands cupping one end of a single dumbbell overhead.
exercises.stance: Standing or seated, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Hold the dumbbell straight overhead.
Lower it behind your head by bending the elbows.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the triceps.
Straighten the arms to return.
cues: Elbows point forward and stay close.
exercises.breathing: In as you lower, out as you extend.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulders.
exercises.stance: Hanging with legs straight or knees bent, body still.
steps: Hang from the bar with arms straight.
Pull your shoulder blades down, then pull your chest toward the bar.
Get your chin over the bar.
Lower all the way with control.
cues: Start each rep from a full hang.
Drive elbows down toward your back pockets.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Underhand grip, about shoulder-width apart.
exercises.stance: Hanging, body still.
steps: Hang with palms facing you.
Pull until your chin passes the bar.
Squeeze your back and biceps.
Lower fully with control.
mistakes: Craning the neck to reach the bar.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulders.
exercises.stance: One knee or both feet in a band looped over the bar.
steps: Loop a band over the bar and place a knee or foot in it.
Hang with arms straight.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower slowly.
cues: Use the lightest band that lets you do clean reps.
Control the band on the way down.
mistakes: Band too strong to feel the back working.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip, wider than shoulders.
exercises.stance: Seated, thighs under the pads, feet flat.
steps: Grip the bar and sit with thighs secured.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
Let the bar rise until the arms are straight.
cues: Bar to the upper chest, not behind the neck.
mistakes: Leaning far back and rowing it.
Letting the weight yank the arms up.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Neutral grip on a V-handle.
exercises.stance: Seated, feet on the platform, knees slightly bent.
steps: Sit tall holding the handle with straight arms.
Pull the handle to your stomach.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Rounding the back at the front.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Neutral grip, palm facing your body.
exercises.stance: One hand and knee on a bench or sturdy chair, other foot on the floor; or a staggered stance with one hand on a table.
steps: Support yourself with one hand, back flat.
Let the dumbbell hang under the shoulder.
Row it toward your hip.
Lower until the arm is straight, then switch sides after the set.
cues: Pull toward the hip, not the chest.
exercises.breathing: Out as you row, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip, a little wider than shoulders.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart, hinged forward with a flat back, knees soft.
steps: Hinge forward with the bar hanging at arm's length.
Row the bar to your lower ribs.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.
cues: Brace your stomach the whole set.
mistakes: Standing up more with each rep.
exercises.breathing: Out as you row, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip on a bar set at about hip height, shoulder-width apart.
exercises.stance: Lying under the bar, heels on the floor, body straight.
steps: Hang under the bar with straight arms and a straight body.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower until the arms are straight.
cues: Bend the knees to make it easier.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand or neutral grip on a rope attachment, thumbs toward you.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width, cable at upper-chest to face height.
steps: Hold the rope with arms straight in front.
Pull it toward your face, splitting the rope apart.
Finish with hands beside the ears and elbows high.
Return slowly.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip on a light band, hands shoulder-width apart.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart, arms straight in front at shoulder height.
steps: Hold the band in front with straight arms.
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.
cues: Shoulders down away from the ears.
exercises.breathing: Out as you pull apart, in as you return.

exercises.grip: Underhand grip, palms facing forward.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart, elbows by your sides.
steps: Hold the dumbbells at your sides.
Curl them up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly until the arms are straight.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Neutral grip, palms facing each other.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Hold the dumbbells at your sides, palms in.
Curl them up without rotating the wrists.
Pause near the shoulders.
Lower slowly.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Forearms on the floor, elbows under the shoulders.
exercises.stance: Feet hip-width apart on the toes, body in a straight line.
steps: Set your forearms on the floor under your shoulders.
Step your feet back and lift the body.
Hold a straight line from head to heels.
Rest on the knees if form breaks.
cues: Squeeze glutes and brace your stomach.
Push the floor away with the forearms.
exercises.breathing: Slow, steady breathing throughout.

exercises.grip: Forearm on the floor under the shoulder.
exercises.stance: Lying on your side, feet stacked or staggered, knees straight (or bent to make it easier).
steps: Lie on your side propped on one forearm.
Lift your hips so the body is straight.
Hold.
Switch sides.
cues: Straight line from head to feet.
mistakes: Rotating the chest toward the floor.
exercises.breathing: Steady breathing.

exercises.grip: Arms reaching straight up toward the ceiling.
exercises.stance: Lying on your back, hips and knees bent to 90 degrees.
steps: Lie on your back with arms up and knees over the hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides.
cues: Lower back stays in contact with the floor.
mistakes: Lower back arching off the floor.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as the arm and leg extend, in as they return.

exercises.grip: Hands crossed on the chest or lightly beside the head.
exercises.stance: Lying on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
cues: Curl the ribs toward the hips.
mistakes: Yanking the head with the hands.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl up, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Arms flat on the floor by your sides.
exercises.stance: Lying on your back, knees bent at 90 degrees, shins parallel to the floor.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet lifted.
Curl your hips up off the floor toward your chest.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
cues: Roll the pelvis, don't swing the legs.
exercises.breathing: Out as you curl, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Overhand grip on a pull-up bar, shoulder-width apart.
exercises.stance: Hanging, legs together.
steps: Hang with arms straight and shoulders engaged.
Raise your knees or straight legs toward the chest.
Curl the pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
mistakes: Only lifting the legs without curling the pelvis.
exercises.breathing: Out as you raise, in as you lower.

exercises.grip: Hands clasped together in front of the chest.
exercises.stance: Seated, knees bent, heels on the floor (or lifted to make it harder), torso leaning back slightly.
steps: Sit and lean back slightly with a straight back.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate to the other side.
Each side counts as one rep.
cues: Rotate from the ribs, not just the arms.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you rotate.

exercises.grip: Arms extended overhead.
exercises.stance: Lying face down, legs straight.
steps: Lie face down with arms overhead.
Lift arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold for 2 to 3 seconds.
Lower slowly.
cues: Small lift; you don't need height.
mistakes: Lifting too high and straining the lower back.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you lift.

exercises.grip: Hands flat under the shoulders.
exercises.stance: High plank, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Drive one knee toward the chest.
Switch legs quickly.
Keep alternating at a steady pace.
exercises.breathing: Short, rhythmic breaths.

exercises.grip: No grip; arms move freely.
exercises.stance: Feet together, knees soft.
steps: Stand with feet together.
Jump and spread arms and legs into a star.
Land softly with feet together.
Repeat at a steady rhythm.
cues: Land softly on the balls of the feet.
mistakes: Going too fast and losing control.
exercises.breathing: Rhythmic breathing.

exercises.grip: Hands behind the head or swinging for momentum.
exercises.stance: Feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Squat down to a comfortable depth.
Jump straight up explosively.
Land softly and go straight into the next squat.
Repeat.
cues: Reset between reps if form slips.
mistakes: Doing them when tired and sloppy.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you jump.

exercises.grip: One hand on the kettlebell handle, overhand.
exercises.stance: Feet slightly wider than shoulders, toes slightly out.
steps: Hike the kettlebell back between your legs, hinging at the hips.
Snap the hips forward to float the bell to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge again.
Switch hands after the set.
cues: It's a hip hinge, not a squat.
Arm is a rope; the hips do the work.
Stand tall at the top with glutes squeezed.
mistakes: Rounding the back at the bottom.
exercises.breathing: Sharp breath out as the hips snap forward.

exercises.grip: Hands flat under the shoulders.
exercises.stance: On hands and knees, knees under the hips.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Round your back up toward the ceiling, tucking the chin.
Then let the stomach drop and lift the chest.
Move slowly between the two.
cues: Move one segment of the spine at a time.
Go only as far as is comfortable.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you round, in as you arch.

exercises.grip: Arms extended forward on the floor.
exercises.stance: Kneeling, big toes together, knees apart.
steps: Kneel and sit back toward your heels.
Walk your hands forward and lower your chest.
Rest your forehead on the floor or a cushion.
Hold and breathe.
exercises.breathing: Slow breaths into the back of the ribs.

exercises.grip: Hands on the front knee or hips.
exercises.stance: Half kneeling: one knee down, the other foot forward.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift forward gently until you feel the stretch at the front of the back hip.
Hold, then switch sides.
cues: Tuck the tailbone; don't arch the back.
Pad under the knee if needed.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing, relax into the stretch.

exercises.grip: Hands may rest lightly on the back of the head (no pulling).
exercises.stance: Seated or standing tall.
steps: Sit or stand tall.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Hold where you feel a gentle stretch along the back of the neck.
Return slowly.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing.

exercises.grip: One hand can rest on the head without pulling.
exercises.stance: Seated or standing tall.
steps: Sit tall with shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your ear toward your shoulder.
Hold a gentle stretch on the opposite side of the neck.
Switch sides.
mistakes: Lifting the shoulder to the ear.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing.

exercises.grip: Hands on the thigh of the bent leg.
exercises.stance: One heel forward on the floor with toes up, back knee slightly bent.
steps: Place one heel forward with the toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back.
Hold where you feel the stretch behind the thigh and calf.
Switch sides.
cues: Hinge from the hips, not by rounding.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing.

exercises.grip: Arms wrapped around the shins.
exercises.stance: Lying on your back.
steps: Lie on your back.
Bring both knees toward the chest.
Hug the shins gently.
Hold and relax the lower back.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing.

exercises.grip: Opposite hand holds the working arm above the elbow.
exercises.stance: Standing or seated tall.
steps: Bring one arm across your chest.
Use the other hand to gently pull it closer.
Hold the stretch at the back of the shoulder.
Switch sides.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing.

exercises.grip: Fingers interlaced, palms facing away.
exercises.stance: Standing or seated tall.
steps: Interlace your fingers in front of you.
Push your hands forward and round your upper back.
Let your head drop slightly.
Hold and breathe into the upper back.
exercises.breathing: Breathe slowly into the upper back.

exercises.grip: Hands loosely clasped or fists.
exercises.stance: Seated or standing.
steps: Hold your arms in front.
Circle the wrists slowly in one direction.
Switch direction halfway.
Keep the movement smooth.
exercises.breathing: Normal breathing.

exercises.grip: Arms extended out to the sides.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Lift your arms out to the sides.
Make small circles, growing bigger.
Reverse direction halfway.
Keep shoulders down.
cues: Good warm-up before upper body work.
exercises.breathing: Normal breathing.

exercises.grip: No grip. Arms hang loose or rest in your lap.
exercises.stance: Seated or standing tall.
steps: Let your arms hang relaxed.
Roll your shoulders forward, up, back and down in a slow circle.
Switch direction halfway.
Keep the neck long and relaxed.
cues: Squeeze the shoulder blades on the way back.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as the shoulders rise, out as they drop.

exercises.grip: Free hand holds the seat or armrest.
exercises.stance: Seated upright on a steady chair, feet flat.
steps: Sit tall with both feet on the floor.
Reach one arm overhead.
Lean gently to the opposite side until you feel the side of your back stretch.
Hold, come back to centre, switch sides.
cues: Both hips stay on the seat.
mistakes: Lifting a hip off the chair.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing into the stretched side.

exercises.grip: Hands on the lower back, fingers pointing down.
exercises.stance: Standing tall, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Stand tall and place both hands on your lower back.
Point your elbows out to the sides.
Gently draw the elbows back toward each other to open the chest.
Hold, then relax.
cues: Shoulders down, away from the ears.
Opens up a hunched desk posture.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as the chest opens.

exercises.grip: One hand can rest on the desk for balance.
exercises.stance: Standing in a short split stance, front knee soft.
steps: Stand with one foot a step in front of the other.
Bend both knees slightly and lift the back heel.
Tuck your tailbone under and press the back hip forward.
Hold, then switch sides.
cues: Squeeze the glute of the back leg.
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of tucking the pelvis.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing; relax a little more on each breath out.

exercises.grip: Hold one wrist with the other hand at hip height.
exercises.stance: Standing, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Cross one arm in front of your body.
Hold that wrist with your other hand, elbow slightly bent.
Gently pull the arm across and up toward shoulder height.
Feel the stretch in the upper back, then switch sides.
cues: Stretch should be in the back, not the joint.
exercises.breathing: Slow, steady breathing.

exercises.grip: Hold the sides of the seat.
exercises.stance: Seated near the front of a steady chair.
steps: Sit tall near the front of the chair.
Straighten one leg in front, heel on the floor, toes up.
Hinge forward from the hips with a straight back until the back of the thigh stretches.
Hold, then switch legs.
cues: Hinge at the hips, chest proud.
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach further.
Sitting on a chair with wheels.
exercises.breathing: Breathe out as you hinge forward.

exercises.grip: Palms together or fingers interlaced overhead.
exercises.stance: Standing or seated tall.
steps: Stand tall and reach both arms straight overhead.
Press the palms together.
Reach up and slightly back, growing tall.
Hold, then lower the arms slowly.
cues: Shoulders away from the ears at the start.
exercises.breathing: Breathe in as you reach up.

exercises.grip: Palms flat, fingers pointing back toward you.
exercises.stance: Standing at a desk, or kneeling on a mat.
steps: Place your palms flat on the desk (or the floor if kneeling), fingers pointing toward you.
Keep the elbows straight but not locked.
Lean back slowly until the inside of the forearms stretches.
Hold, then turn the hands over (backs flat) for the other side of the forearm.
cues: Lean only as far as is comfortable.
Good for keyboard and phone-heavy days.
exercises.breathing: Slow breathing.
